problem: Full-width square maps overflowed the Tablet display and appeared zoomed/cropped; desktop controls were oversized.
fix: Fit Explore and Field data canvases to both available width and height, preserving square geometry and full coverage.
Resize with the pane/window and notices; retain map pan/zoom while changing layout.
Keep map symbols and the metric scale legible at smaller display sizes.
Use compact Explore controls on wide screens with a fine pointer; retain touch-sized controls for coarse pointers.
Show mouse, keyboard and touch navigation hints.
